item.content: {"url": "https://api.crossref.org/works?query=formal+foundational+analyses+comparing+causal-state+reconstruction+with+physical+coarse-graining+limits&rows=4&select=DOI%2Ctitle%2Cabstract%2CURL%2Cpublished", "scope": "Crossref bibliographic metadata and abstracts where supplied; not full papers", "excerpt": "[{\"DOI\": \"10.20944/preprints202609.2210.v1\", \"title\": [\"Causal Coarse-Graining and the Almeida Growth Index: A Micro–Macro Research Program Within the Dead Universe Theory\"], \"abstract\": \"<jats:p>The value γ_A = (√5 − 1)/2, established within the effective DUT formulation, is shown to be consistent with a distinct causal coarse-graining framework based on a two-channel, unit-multiplicity history architecture. Within this framework, the causal-history dynamics generate a structural constraint compatible with γ_A. Within the two-channel integer-multiplicity family, (p,q)=(1,1) is further shown to be the unique discrete architecture compatible with the previously established DUT value γ_A, establishing algebraic uniqueness within this causal class. This consistency supports the interpretation of γ_A as a robust structural parameter of causal coarse-graining rather than a model-specific artifact. We develop a unified analysis based on the non-minimally coupled scalar action, exact compactification of z = ξS², slow–fast reduction, exact second-order response theory, minimal state-space realization, and Mori–Zwanzig projection. The exact transformation O = z/(1 + z), D = 1/(1 + z) implies D/O = 1/z. The microscopic response possesses a minimal two-dimensional realization and, away from critical damping, two distinct simple physical poles. Exact temporal sampling proves that the signed local scalar amplitude does not coincide with the positive history-counting variable, while projection onto the relevant scalar–curvature observable yields the explicit memory kernel K(t) = PLQ · e^(QLQt) · QLP; for the locally stationary damped realization this reduces to K(t) = −ω² · e^(−Γt), with effective projected resolvent G_eff(s) = (s + Γ)/(s² + Γs + ω²). The causal-history architecture is represented by two exhaustive, disjoint unit-cardinality extension classes, giving p = q = 1 and hence N_n = N_(n−1) + N_(n−2).
